content: Elihu u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yoobu, sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ Gusunɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɑ nɛɛ,
bɑɑ ɑ̀ n dɛɛre, ɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑsi,
ɑ̀ kun mɑɑ durum kue mbɑ yen ɑrufɑɑni,
ɑ tɑmɑɑ yeni yɑ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee?
A tɑmɑɑ ɑ ɡem mɔ Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ?
Nɛnɑ kon bɛɛ wisi wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bɔrɔ be.
A wɔllu mɛɛrio, kpɑ ɑ ɡuru winu lɑɑkɑri ko
nɡe mɛ nu tomɑ.
À n durum kuɑ, tɑɑrɛ yerɑ̀ ɑ Gusunɔ kuɑ.
À n mɑɑ wunɛn durum sosimɔ,
mbɑ yɑ nùn kuɑmmɛ.
À n ɡeɑ mɔ̀, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ yɑ kɑ nùn nɑɑwɑmmɛ.
Mbɑ u wɑɑmɔ wunɛn nɔmɑn di.
A n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛn berusewɑ wunɛn nuku kɔ̃suru tɑ koo nɔni sɔ̃.
À n mɑɑ ɡeɑ mɔ̀, tɔnuwɑ u koo yen ɑrufɑɑni di.
Bɑ̀ n tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ bɑ rɑ n weeweenu mɔ̀wɑ,
kpɑ bɑ n somiru kɑsu.
Adɑmɑ bɑɑ ben turo kun bikiɑmɔ u nɛɛ,
mɑnɑ Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ wi u nùn tɑkɑ kuɑ,
wi, wi u rɑ de wɔnwɔndobu bɑ n nuku dobun womusu mɔ̀ wɔ̃kuru.
Wiyɑ u rɑ mɑɑ tɔmbu bwisi kɛ̃
n kere yɛɛɡii kɑ ɡunɔsuɡii.
Bɑ̀ n somiru kɑnɑ Gusunɔ u ku rɑ wure,
yèn sɔ̃ bɑ tii sue mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu.
Bɑ ko n kuuki mɔ̀, ɑdɑmɑ kɑm sɔɔrɑ mi.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡii u ǹ nɔɔmɔ u sere ben lɑɑkɑri ko.
Yoobu, bɑɑ mɛ ɑ ɡeruɑ ɑ nɛɛ,
ɑ ǹ Gusunɔ wɑɑmɔ, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ u wunɛn lɑɑkɑri mɔ̀.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ tɛmɑnɔ ɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑki.
Yèn sɔ̃ Gusunɔ u ǹ tɔmbu sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ tɛ̃,
yen sɔ̃nɑ ɑ tɑmɑɑ u ǹ durum ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu?
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ kpuro yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wom dirum.
Yi ǹ mɑɑ ɑsɑnsi mɔ.

content: Nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u rɑ kɑ tɔnu wɑ̃ɑrun swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsi
